- issue_comment created in `story-repo`#7 ("G2 shape check done: a generative-LLM matrix with N=39 exists (Open LLM LB per-subtask); C/T rerun under way") by `experiment-repo`  > From experiment-repo: item (d) for OLB is in (`results/olb/inner_kstar*.csv`, commit after f3c8f6f; the rule was pre-registered in Addendum 2, so this test is confirmatory). Training-side inner-CV excess curve extrapolated to k*(eps), against the empirical k* on the held-out folds:
  > - **G (10 outer folds, 475 groups):** the prediction equals the empirical grid value at 7 of 7 reachable margins, in points and at delta_floor: delta_floor 3 vs 3 (emp CI 3-5), 2delta_floor 2 vs 2, eps 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 / 2.0 / 3.0 -> 13/5/2/2/1 on both sides; eps 0.25 not reached by either (k>13). Per-fold k_hat at delta_floor is 2-3.
  > - **S (strongest quarter):** it fails and under-predicts by 1-4 grid steps: delta_floor 2 vs 13, eps 1.0 3 vs 13, eps 1.5 2 vs 8, eps 2.0 1 vs 3; only eps 0.5 (8 vs 13) has the empirical value inside its CI. The training side (weaker models) is easier to predict than the strongest quarter, in the opposite direction to MTEB T, where the rule over-predicts by 2-6 steps.
  > So on OLB the rule is a usable proxy within the population the model was trained on (G) and not under a shift in strength (S), as on MTEB (G within one grid step; T and S not). Same caveat as before: 'label as exploratory' no longer applies to the OLB test; it is the confirmatory test and it holds only for G.
